item.title: Plug 0.5.0
item.description:
• Filter by maker: a Maker picker on New, Deals and Updates, with every maker's count, a search box, and A–Z or Most. Right-click a card for Show Only <maker>.
  • By maker: group New and Deals under each maker's name, A to Z.
  • News and deal posts now show who makes the plug-in, read off the title (96 % of plug-ins get a maker).
